title: This AI can read your mind and it's terrifying

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: If AI could truly read our minds, how would that reshape our trust in technology and our own privacy?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Current neural interfaces like Elon Musk's Neuralink can decode basic brain signals, but full mind-reading remains science fiction.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: The risk of manipulation, loss of autonomy, and mass surveillance would erode trust in both AI and human institutions.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Engineers are prioritizing encryption, consent protocols, and transparency in neural data to prevent misuse.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: In the future, mind-reading AI could enable seamless communication for those with paralysis, enhancing human connection.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future will balance innovation with safeguards, ensuring mind-reading AI serves humanity without controlling it.

video_cue: A split screen showing a brain interface with glowing neural pathways on one side and a secure data lock on the other.
